title: avsp - add subtypes greentap, greent, dzgre
description: AVSP is the Arista Networks Vendor Specific L2 header format.  It includes a subtype and version that specify what follows.  The current dissector only supported two subtypes (timestamp and TGEN).  This adds several more.  GRE Encapsulated Telemetry (GREENT) is a packet sampling mechanism that attaches a timestamp and interface information to one or more packet samples and forwards them encapsulated in a GRE header.  GRE ENcapsulated TAP (GREENTAP) and DzGRE are hardware forwarding mechanisms that similarly tag a packet with a timestamp and switch information and forwards the packet encapsulated with a GRE header.
